questions:
• What are two main ways technology has improved daily life?
• Describe a skill you learned recently. How did you learn it?
• Do you prefer studying alone or with a group? Why?
reading:
Learning a language is a marathon, not a sprint. Many students begin with great enthusiasm, study for long hours in the first week, and then stop completely. The students who succeed are rarely the ones with the most talent — they are the ones who show up every day, even for fifteen minutes.

Consistency works because the brain needs repetition spread over time. Reviewing a word once for an hour is far less effective than meeting the same word for two minutes on five different days. This is why daily practice beats weekend marathons.
vocabulary:
consistency – doing something regularly over a long period
enthusiasm – strong excitement and interest
repetition – doing or seeing something again and again
effective – producing the result you want
marathon – a very long race; something needing endurance
